abilities.name: Tool Volley

traits.name: Attack
traits.text: An ability with this trait involves an attack. For each attack you make beyond the first on your turn, you take a multiple attack penalty.

abilities.trigger: A living creature comes within 15 feet of the trap; Effect The trap makes a tool Strike against the triggering creature. The trap then rolls initiative.

abilities.effect: The trap makes a tool Strike against the triggering creature.
abilities.name: Continuous Barrage
abilities.trigger: A creature within 15 feet finishes an action

hazard.description: Animated awls, hammers, nails, and other tools hurl themselves off the tool bench at intruders.
hazard.disable: DC 33 Diplomacy (master) to soothe the psychic echoes, DC 32 Religion (expert) to overwhelm the area's energy, or DC 32 Occultism (expert) to counter the psychic echoes; on the third successful check, the psychic echoes are disrupted, and the trap is destroyed.
hazard.name: Flinging Tools
hazard.routine: (1 action) The trap launches one tool against every living creature within 15 feet as 1 action. Because it flings tools continuously, the trap can also use the Continuous Barrage free action to fling tools at each creature during that creature's turn.

traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.

traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
